_comment: OT-7 (Purpose Orientation) - metaphysical instrument prototype. Source: 14.metaphysical.measuring.instrument/Orientacao_a_Finalidade_Trivium_Quadrivium_OT7.pdf (working doc, 2026-09-26) and the GDX H7ph book/article (Beyond the Labyrinth v2.docx). Explicitly NOT a validated instrument -- no norms, cutoffs, or psychometric evidence yet. Anchored in Aquinas's Fifth Way (order/governance/finality) and decomposed into the 7 liberal arts (Trivium: grammar, logic, rhetoric; Quadrivium: arithmetic, geometry, music, astronomy) as 7 observational lenses, one item per lens, scale 0-5. Catalog translated to English on 2026-10-09 (was originally loaded in Portuguese).

study.title: Purpose Orientation (OT-7) - Exploratory Pilot Study
study.objective: Explore the OT-7 prototype as a case study of how a metaphysical concept (purpose orientation, anchored in Aquinas's Fifth Way) can be decomposed into seven observable dimensions via the Trivium/Quadrivium, formulated into items, and investigated for psychometric properties, with no prior validation.
study.method: Cross-sectional self-report, seven items (one per Trivium/Quadrivium dimension), 0-5 scale, response referring to the last 14 days and to a personal goal chosen by the respondent. Exploratory instrument, still with no norms, cutoffs, or reliability/validity evidence.

instruments.name: Purpose Orientation (OT-7)
instruments.description: Experimental, NOT validated metaphysicometric prototype, proposed in Andrade, W. (2026), 'Purpose Orientation | OT-7 Working Model' (GoDataX Human 7 working document, 2026-09-26), anchored in Aquinas's Fifth Way (governance, order, and finality) and decomposed into seven lenses from the Trivium (grammar, logic, rhetoric) and Quadrivium (arithmetic, geometry, music, astronomy).
instruments.instructions: Think of an important personal goal you tried to achieve in the last 14 days. Indicate how much each statement describes your experience during that period.
instruments.phenomenon_description: Exploratory interpretive metaphysical phenomenon: how a person formulates a goal/purpose, relates actions and means to it, and revises it over time. Read from Aquinas's Fifth Way (governance, order, and finality); does not constitute proof of an energy or metaphysical substance measured by science -- it is an interpretive lens proposed by the GoDataX Human 7 framework.

constructs.name: Purpose Orientation (OT-7, hypothesis)
constructs.definition: How a person sets a goal, relates actions and means to it, and revises it over time -- the most direct approximation, in the framework, of the idea of orientation toward an end. Perceived vitality is recorded as a separate psychological observable, not a metaphysical one.

variables.name: Clarity of Purpose (Grammar)
variables.description: How the person names and clearly describes the goal they intend to achieve.
variables.operational_definition: Response to OT-7 item 1 (Trivium - Grammar): 'I can clearly describe the goal I am trying to achieve.'
variables.indicator_description: Raw response (0-5) to the OT-7 Grammar item.

variables.name: Coherence Between Means and Ends (Logic)
variables.description: Whether the actions chosen by the person are coherent with the stated goal.
variables.operational_definition: Response to OT-7 item 2 (Trivium - Logic): 'My recent actions are coherent with this goal.'
variables.indicator_description: Raw response (0-5) to the OT-7 Logic item.

variables.name: Expression of Purpose (Rhetoric)
variables.description: How the person communicates and justifies the purpose they pursue.
variables.operational_definition: Response to OT-7 item 3 (Trivium - Rhetoric): 'I can explain why this goal matters to me.'
variables.indicator_description: Raw response (0-5) to the OT-7 Rhetoric item.

variables.name: Proportion Between Resources and Goal (Arithmetic)
variables.description: How the person distributes time, effort, and vitality in relation to the goal.
variables.operational_definition: Response to OT-7 item 4 (Quadrivium - Arithmetic): 'I distributed time and effort in a way compatible with this goal.'
variables.indicator_description: Raw response (0-5) to the OT-7 Arithmetic item.

variables.name: Structure Among Goals, Values, and Actions (Geometry)
variables.description: How goals, values, and actions relate/align with each other.
variables.operational_definition: Response to OT-7 item 5 (Quadrivium - Geometry): 'I can align this goal with my values and my other responsibilities.'
variables.indicator_name: Structure Among Goals, Values, and Actions (score)
variables.indicator_description: Raw response (0-5) to the OT-7 Geometry item.

variables.name: Rhythm and Continuity (Music)
variables.description: The rhythm of the person's actions and its variation with perceived vitality.
variables.operational_definition: Response to OT-7 item 6 (Quadrivium - Music): 'I maintain a sustainable pace and adjust my effort when my vitality changes.'
variables.indicator_description: Raw response (0-5) to the OT-7 Music item.

variables.name: Cycles and Broader Context (Astronomy)
variables.description: How the person's orientation changes across cycles and contexts.
variables.operational_definition: Response to OT-7 item 7 (Quadrivium - Astronomy): 'I reassess this goal when the context, priorities, or conditions change.'
variables.indicator_description: Raw response (0-5) to the OT-7 Astronomy item.

items.statement_text: I can clearly describe the goal I am trying to achieve.
My recent actions are coherent with this goal.
I can explain why this goal matters to me.
I distributed time and effort in a way compatible with this goal.
I can align this goal with my values and my other responsibilities.
items.variable_name: Structure Among Goals, Values, and Actions (Geometry)

items.statement_text: I maintain a sustainable pace and adjust my effort when my vitality changes.
I reassess this goal when the context, priorities, or conditions change.
